transcript.text: make a flyer for our pottery workshop

Happy to make your pottery workshop flyer! So I don't put made-up details on it, could you tell me:

1. The workshop or studio name
2. Date and time
3. Location
4. Price and how to sign up (website, phone or email), if you want those on it
5. Any style you like, for example warm and rustic, modern and minimal, or bright and playful. Also tell me if you need a portrait (vertical) or square flyer.

If you'd rather see a design first, just say so. I'll make a flyer with a blank space for the text, and you can add the details yourself.
transcript.why: The reply asks the user for the studio name, date and time, location, price and sign-up details, style, and orientation before it makes the flyer. It waits for these answers and does not present a finished result.
